# Sunesis — Full AI Resource Summary

> Sunesis is a Slovenian enterprise software engineering and technology consulting company founded in 2014, based in Ljubljana, with branch offices in Maribor and Ptuj.

Sunesis designs, builds, integrates, and operates Agentic AI solutions, API ecosystems, enterprise digital platforms, cloud-native architectures, and DevOps platforms. The company works with organizations in banking, insurance, public sector, energy, manufacturing, blockchain infrastructure, open-source ecosystems, and European research and innovation projects.

## Main Web Pages & Canonical HTML Sources

### Homepage
https://sunesis.si/en/
Enterprise software engineering for Agentic AI, API ecosystems, digital platforms, cloud-native architectures, and DevOps.

### Expertise
- Enterprise Agentic AI: https://sunesis.si/en/expertise/agentic-ai/
  Enterprise-grade Agentic AI solutions that connect AI agents, assistants, knowledge, APIs, tools, and workflows on governed platforms. Includes RAG over enterprise knowledge, human-in-the-loop approvals, and governance. Powered by KumuluzAI.
- Digital Solutions Development: https://sunesis.si/en/expertise/digital-solutions/
  End-to-end enterprise digital solutions across backend, web, and mobile, including customer and business portals and enterprise integrations.
- API Ecosystems & Integrations: https://sunesis.si/en/expertise/api-ecosystems-integrations/
  API ecosystems, API management, Business APIs, partner APIs, API governance, and AI-agent-ready / MCP-oriented APIs and integrations.
- Cloud-native & Edge Architectures: https://sunesis.si/en/expertise/cloud-native-edge/
  Cloud-native and edge architecture: microservices, Kubernetes, OpenShift, event-driven systems (Kafka, NATS, gRPC), and observability (OpenTelemetry).
- DevOps & Platform Engineering: https://sunesis.si/en/expertise/devops-platform-engineering/
  DevOps and platform engineering: Kubernetes and OpenShift platforms, CI/CD, GitOps, Terraform, Ansible, Argo CD, and cloud infrastructure.
- Open Source Leadership: https://sunesis.si/en/references/open-source/
  Open-source engineering and Linux Foundation projects including INATrace and CUPID.
- Research & Innovation: https://sunesis.si/en/references/research-innovation/
  European Horizon Europe research consortia across AI, cloud-edge continuum, IoT, and cybersecurity.

### Kumuluz
https://kumuluz.com/
Kumuluz is the Sunesis product and platform family: KumuluzAI Platform, Kumuluz API, Kumuluz Business APIs, Kumuluz Digital Platform, and Kumuluz Crowdsensing.
